name: auric
description: Auric Ulvin, the Illian hero and god-king of winter: an old king with long flowing white hair and a long white beard, a crown of spiky ice-blue crystals, silver-blue plate armour studded with round ice-blue gems, a grey cloth skirt, a long white fur mantle and white hair streaming down his screen-left side to the ground, and a huge glowing ice-blue crystal greatsword held by the end of its hilt in his RIGHT hand, which reaches across his body to the screen-right side, the blade angled up to the upper-right
hands: the crystal greatsword's hilt end stays in his right hand, which reaches across his body to the screen-right side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the hilt just under the crossguard, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the left hand lets go of the hilt, the ice-blue crystal greatsword is lifted up over the head in the right hand with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the crystal greatsword cocked behind the head with the ice-blue blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty left fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the ice-blue crystal blade is level, pointing to the lower-left, the empty left fist pulled back
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the crystal greatsword slashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the crystal greatsword carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, the long white hair and mantle trailing back, the empty left fist held back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the crystal greatsword lifts back toward the ready angle, the left hand reaching back for the hilt

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty left fist flung out to the right, the greatsword arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the crystal greatsword dipping, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the greatsword arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal greatsword lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal greatsword's tip resting on the ground, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the crystal greatsword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the ice crown on his head; the crystal greatsword lies on the ground at the lower-left; the long white hair and mantle spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white hair and mantle settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal greatsword on the ground beside him
